newsitem.title: USA: Bacou USA to buy respiratory businesses.
newsitem.headline: Bacou USA to buy respiratory businesses.

text.p: Bacou USA Inc said on Monday it reached an agreement in principle to buy the respiratory businesses of Survivair in California and the Interspiro group of companies from Comasec International SA.
Terms were not disclosed, but the deal was not expected to close until 1997, said Bacou, which makes safety eyewear, respirators and industrial personal protective equipment.
Survivair makes and sells respiratory products, focusing on self-contained breathing apparatus for industrial applications and fire fighters, the company said.
